relevance.rationale: Already examined in the corpus and recorded as an APPLICABILITY NEGATIVE, correctly. computations/qbeta/qbeta_cusp_shape_drift_robustness_probe.py and its witness name this exact file (library/arxiv-math-0410233v4/0410233v4.pdf) and state: Purcell's Thm 1.2 requires a cone deformation along a singular locus DISJOINT from the cusp torus T, cone angle running 0 -> 2*pi, with T remaining a cusp throughout -- whereas the QOU setup deforms the 4_1 cusp ITSELF (Neumann-Zagier, u = 2 ln q_0 != 0). I read the hypotheses and agree they do not transfer. So the paper is the right subject area (cusp shape bounds, prop:cusp-shape-bar-parity) but supplies no result the folio can consume. This is a scope-(a) negative -- this document, as read, does not close the cusp-shape-drift objection; it is not a claim that no cone-deformation bound could.
